src.title: File:Beautiful Montagu's Harrier in Flight (51042548717).jpg
src.author: Hari K Patibanda
src.description: As the light was fading during the sunset, we sighted maybe a dozen harriers landing one by one. A highlight was the presence of 2-3 sub-adult Montagu's harriers. The fully adult males like this one seem to have an issue with the sub-adults that they would chase them several times - short chases kind of meant to disturb the resting sub-adult. I am not sure why, but maybe its like sibling fight. This adult chased 2 sub-adults away and then made a full long circle (in this shot) to find a nice spot to roost. We sighted ~15 harriers in total which seemed comfortable with us as long as we sat in our vehicle. When we tried step out and crawl closer, they had little patience for our antics and flew away. Many thanks in advance for your views and feedback. Much appreciated.
